categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: intelligent power grid equipment manufacturing and new energy business. The intelligent power grid segment focuses on R&D, production, and sales of power distribution and control equipment such as ring main units, switch cabinets, and modular substations. The new energy segment includes EPC projects for photovoltaic storage and charging, photovoltaic power generation, investment and operation of new energy vehicle charging stations, and R&D and manufacturing of energy storage and charging products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes advanced technologies in power distribution and control equipment, including C-GIS ring main units and specialized cable protection devices. It employs integrated R&D, design, procurement, production, and sales processes with flexible, order-driven manufacturing. In new energy, it utilizes EPC contracting for photovoltaic and storage projects, and develops intelligent charging systems, portable energy storage, and integrated storage-charging solutions. The company is advancing digital upgrades and automation in its production facilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include national and regional power grid companies (State Grid, Southern Grid), China Railway Group, urban rail transit, industrial and mining enterprises, and large energy-consuming commercial and industrial clients. The company serves both domestic markets across various Chinese regions and international markets, particularly targeting emerging markets along the Belt and Road Initiative for power infrastructure projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant sales in East China, Central China, North China, South China, Southwest, Northwest, and Northeast regions. It also has overseas subsidiaries and targets international markets, especially in emerging countries and developed regions undergoing grid modernization. Overseas operations include subsidiaries in the Cayman Islands and Hong Kong.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the power equipment supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and engineering services for power distribution and control equipment. It also extends downstream into EPC contracting, operation of photovoltaic power stations, and new energy vehicle charging infrastructure, integrating upstream procurement of raw materials and components.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening core intelligent power grid manufacturing capabilities, enhancing R&D in high-voltage and smart grid technologies, and expanding new energy business cautiously with risk control. The company invests heavily in R&D for mobile intelligent charging systems, energy storage solutions, and integrated energy management platforms. It plans to accelerate digital transformation of production bases and pursue strategic acquisitions to extend its product portfolio.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of intelligent power grid equipment and new energy products, EPC contracting services for photovoltaic and storage projects, and charging service fees from operating new energy vehicle charging stations. The company also earns income from investment holdings in photovoltaic power stations and related energy management services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a domestic mid-sized player in the power distribution equipment manufacturing industry, competing with large multinational firms like ABB and Siemens in the high-voltage segment, and numerous domestic manufacturers in the medium and low-voltage segments. It leverages its integrated capabilities and customer relationships in power grids and rail transit to maintain competitiveness. In new energy, it faces competition amid rapid industry growth and policy shifts.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately RMB 1.15 billion, a 30.85% decline from 2023, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 77.5 million. The decline was driven by reduced power construction service revenue and strategic divestments in photovoltaic assets. The company’s total assets were about RMB 2.9 billion with a net asset value of RMB 1.24 billion. It faces profitability challenges but continues investing in R&D and digital upgrades to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its strong R&D capabilities, proprietary technologies, and integrated product-service solutions in intelligent power grid equipment and new energy systems. It offers customized, high-quality products with advanced features such as smart grid integration, modular design, and energy efficiency. Its synergy between traditional power equipment and new energy businesses provides comprehensive energy internet solutions, enhancing customer value through innovation, reliability, and tailored services.
